hxcontainer.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit container API. Containers are used to group a set of child widgets.

Enumeration Type Documentation

enum HxContainerAttributes_t

Definitions for container attributes.

Enumerator:
kHxContainerAttrNone 
kHxContainerAttrFocusable  The container receives focus, with a focus ring drawn around the container when the container has the focus.
kHxContainerAttrNoFocusRing  Set the kHxContainerAttrNoFocusRing attribute if the container is focusable, but should not have a focus ring drawn around it. This is sometimes desired for the main content container, like the web content container or the text document container. Because the container is focusable, it can also receive input events, such as scroll wheel events.
kHxContainerAttrHasFrame  The container is drawn with a frame.
kHxContainerAttrHasResizerH  The container has a control that the user can use to resize the container horizontally. A frame is always drawn with the resizer. This feature is not implemented in the current platform release, but the flag bit is reserved for a future implementation.
kHxContainerAttrHasResizerV  The container has a control that the user can use to resize the container vertically. A frame is always drawn with the resizer. This feature is not implemented in the current platform release, but the flag bit is reserved for a future implementation.
kHxContainerAttrKeepTabs  Set the kHxContainerAttrKeepTabs attribute if tabs should not be passed on to the system for changing widget focus. If this attribute is set, tabs do not change focus when the container, or any of the container's children, have focus.
kHxContainerAttrKeepEnters  Set the kHxContainerAttrKeepEnters attribute if pressing the Enter key should not be passed on to the system for acting on a command button that is not a child of the container.
kHxContainerAttrKeepEvents  Set the kHxContainerAttrKeepEvents attribute if events should not be passed on to children of the container. Instead, the container's event handlers will be called.
kHxContainerAttrRoundedBottom  Set the kHxContainerAttrRoundedBottom attribute if the bottom left and bottom right corners of the container should instead have rounded edges in place of the corner. kHxContainerAttrHasFrame must also be specified for this to take effect.
kHxContainerAttrAll

Function Documentation

HxResult HxContainerDelete ( HxContainer_t *  pContainer  ) 

Delete a container widget.

HxContainerDelete deletes a container created from an earlier call to HxContainerNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxContainerDelete only needs to be called when removing a container at runtime.

Parameters:
pContainer IN: Pointer to the container to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxContainerNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pBounds,
HxContainerAttributes_t  attr,
HxContainer_t **  hContainer 
)

Create a container widget.

HxContainerNew creates a container widget, which can be used to group widgets in a scrollable pane.

The container is the parent of its contained widgets. The children widgets placed in a container are positioned relative to the container's origin: a child with a top-left origin of (0,0) is positioned at the top left corner of the container.

The attr argument can be a logically OR'ed set of HxContainerAttributes_t fags.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to the container's parent widget
pBounds IN: Pointer to the container bounds
attr IN: One or more HxContainerAttributes_t flags
hContainer OUT: Handle to the created container
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails, and sets *hContainer to NULL. HX_INVALID_ARG if size is too small for the specified attributes.

HxResult HxContainerScroll ( HxContainer_t *  pContainer,
HxScrollbarAttributes_t  scrollAttr,
int32_t  delta 
)

Scroll the widgets within a container.

HxContainerScroll scrolls all the child widgets within a container by delta pixels. The widgets scroll either horizontally or vertically, based on the scrollAttr argument.

delta is negative or positive depending on the scrolling direction. For example, to scroll widgets up, delta is negative.

Parameters:
pContainer IN: Pointer to a container
scrollAttr IN: Scrollbar attribute (vertical vs horizontal)
delta IN: Number of pixels to scroll
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxContainerSetBackgroundColor ( HxContainer_t *  pContainer,
const HxColor_t *  pColor 
)

Set the background color used to draw the container.

HxContainerSetBackgroundColor sets the color used to draw the background of the container. The default background color is white, matching the default window background.

The container is updated with the new background color when this function is called.

Parameters:
pContainer IN: Pointer to a container
pColor IN: Pointer to a color structure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
